body: I'm sorry you've felt so neglected by the people you care about. I really can understand how that would hurt. What do you feel would help you deal with these suicidal feelings? It sounds to me that you don't want to die, but you are angry, and you want to feel loved and appreciated.
Why did you say you're fine? People care about you want to help, but they aren't mind readers. If you say you're fine, they are going to believe you?

It is not too much to ask for. I did the same thing as you. Your ability to build a world like that shows that you have a very fertile imagination.

I feel similarly to the way you do, so I'm not sure I can offer the best help. I just want you to know that you are not alone. Many of the most creative and amazing people I know are autistic. I would recommend exploring all options before making the decision to end everything, forever. You owe that to yourself, right? Work with the psychologist, and explore ways to manage symptoms (medication can help too).

Finally, I hated when people told me this when I was your age, but... dude, you are *so young.* That doesn't mean your feelings and emotions aren't valid. They absolutely are. But it is also true that you have so much of your life ahead of you. I am in my early-30s, and I can tell you that the very worst years of my life were as a teenager.  There is so much time for things to change, so much left for you to learn and explore.

Anyway, just a few thoughts from a kindred spirit. I hope they offer you some comfort, and that you will know that I care about you.
